mentions.name: Mini time series database
mentions.description: A mini time series database that stores timestamped floating point values with a series id, backed by a B+Tree data structure, with querying done via a Lisp-like query language.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on my own mini time series database.

It only stores (timestamped) floating point values with a series id and uses a B+Tree as the backing data structure. Querying is done with a lisp-like query language.
